episodes.title: Rise and Shine Sleepyhead
episodes.summary: Ansi, a new resident of the Wayne, must work with siblings Olly and Saraline to stop a rampaging threat deep within their home.

episodes.title: Like a Happy, Happy Bird
episodes.summary: With Ansi on board, Team Timbers follow a mysterious figure into the Wayne's secret library; Ansi tries to protect his new friend and budding crush Julia from a terrifying monster.

episodes.title: Mail Those Cards, Boys!
episodes.summary: After a robotic pigeon steals their mysterious post cards, Team Timbers and Leif must fight their way through the Wayne Postal Service to get them back.

episodes.title: Today Was Wassome
episodes.summary: Tired of being bossed around, Ansi joins forces with Wendell Wasserman, a spoon-wielding vampire hunter, to track down the Wayne's last remaining vampire.

episodes.title: Some Kind of Tap-Dancing, Beekeeping Whaler
episodes.summary: As Olly helps his new neighbor regain his memory, Ansi is convinced that his best friend is in mortal danger.

episodes.title: Like No Other Market on Earth
episodes.summary: On the search for a mysterious rainbow gas, Team Timbers ends up in the Wayne's supernatural supermarket trailed by a dangerous creature determined to break up their friendship forever!

episodes.title: Beeping the Binklemobile
episodes.summary: When the biggest Gleeco competition of the year comes to the Wayne, Ansi meets his biggest competition -- Dennis O'Bannon. But when Ansi's creation comes to life, Team Timbers has to take down the unstoppable Gleeco Man.

episodes.title: Spacefish
episodes.summary: When Olly, Ansi, and Andrei have a boys' bonding night "roof camping" they try to conjure a ghost -- but something even more terrifying appears.

episodes.title: A Pair of Normas
episodes.summary: Team Timbers tries to stop reality TV show hosts from revealing the secrets of the Wayne… and exposing themselves and the world to danger.

episodes.title: It's the Mid-Season Finale
episodes.summary: When a supernatural storm strikes, Olly and Ansi's favorite TV characters come to life. Meanwhile, Saraline learns some terrifying truths about the Wayne from the mysterious figure who has been tracking them.

episodes.title: Hit It, Toofus!
episodes.summary: Olly arranges a long-awaited dinner between his and Ansi's family… but when the Spy unexpectedly shows up, Team Timbers must outsmart the bad guys without their parents finding out.

episodes.title: Wall-to-Wall Ping-Pong Ball
episodes.summary: Team Timbers heads to the Wayne's secret library to find out more about its vampire-filled past. But when they are ambushed by a ninja, they discover that their new friend Andrei could be evil!

episodes.title: Swap Shop Hop & Bop
episodes.summary: At the annual Wayne flea market, Ansi has to let go of his childhood toys, Olly is on a mission to find the ultimate collection, and Andrei's vintage clothing comes to life in pursuit of a mysterious object.
Saraline's 8th birthday turns into a late-night adventure through the Wayne with all of their friends to investigate a strange clue from Tony Stanza.

episodes.title: Flutch
episodes.summary: Ansi gets captured by a talking pipe and taken down to a mysterious kingdom below the Wayne, ruled by a washing machine pharaoh! Team Timbers begins to rely on their new friends for help on their adventures.

episodes.title: What's for Linner?
episodes.summary: Team Timbers follows a magical paper butterfly to a fantastical origami world created by Katherine Alice, a girl without a voice who needs their help.

episodes.title: Leave the Funny, Find the Bunny
episodes.summary: At the Wayne Talent Show, Olly and Ansi put on a magic act and encounter a powerful rabbit bent on revenge.

episodes.title: Gimble in the Wabe
episodes.summary: The Wayne loses power on the hottest day of the year, forcing Team Timbers to search for the fabled swimming pool. A discovery leads them on the trail of the Gyre, a secret organization that can save the Wayne from destruction.

episodes.title: Keep an Eye on the Nose
episodes.summary: Saraline investigates a mysterious walking nose that's loose in the Wayne while Olly is convinced Julia is hiding a major secret.

episodes.title: So This Is Glamsterdam
episodes.summary: With the Spy close to opening the Gates of Glamsterdam, Team Timbers prepares for an all out battle for the Wayne. But where did Ansi go? How will they stop an army of vampires? And where is the Gyre when they need it most?

episodes.title: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Cup
episodes.summary: While Team Timbers and their friends take a break and unplug from technology, a terrifying threat named Eraser Face attempts to erase the Wayne!

episodes.title: Welcome to the Wassermans
episodes.summary: A sleepover at Wendell's turns into a hunt for a mysterious jewel, a battle with a werewolf, and Saraline's biggest nightmare: Olly is becoming a teenager!

episodes.title: An Olly-Day Miracle!
episodes.summary: Today is "Olly Day" and Olly is celebrating his made-up holiday with his biggest crush, the Arcsine! But will the Spy steal her powers?

episodes.title: That's Squidjit Bowling
episodes.summary: It's the Squidjit Bowling Championship, but when Dennis gets injured, it's up to underdog Ansi Molina to defeat the evil HuMannequins or lose his squidjit pal forever!

episodes.title: We're the Wayniacs
episodes.summary: Olly, Ansi and Katherine Alice start a rock band to defeat C.C. Scratch, a heavy metal Wayne Phenomenon who wants to turn everyone into musical instruments!

episodes.title: Curious Brains of the Brain
episodes.summary: At the annual Wayne science fair, Olly accidentally turns himself into a fly! But when he discovers that the Spy is using Saraline's latest science project to steal the Arcsine's powers, it's Olly Fly to the rescue!

episodes.title: Wiles Styles You Over
episodes.summary: Team Timbers gets a total makeover, but it changes more than just their looks. Now, Olly is super smart, Ansi is super strong and Saraline is a social media star!

episodes.title: The Best Buddy I Never Had
episodes.summary: Team Timbers travels inside a magical book that takes them back to when Olly was a baby. But when Olly breaks the book's rules, he may lose his little sister Saraline forever!

episodes.title: Some Sort of Bad Luck Curse
episodes.summary: Saraline's best friend starts turning into an old woman and Olly blames Ansi's bad luck curse. But when Team Timbers discovers the truth, can they save her before time runs out?

episodes.title: Whoever Controls the Wayne, Controls the World
episodes.summary: The evil Prismal is trying to take over the Wayne. Can Olly, Ansi and Saraline stop him before the Wayne… and the world… are covered in darkness?
